_comment: z63s — Codex contextual-user-block parity fixture. Loaded by BOTH backend/internal/codex/contextblocks_test.go and frontend/src/services/codexContextBlocks.test.ts so the Go isContextBlock and the TS isCodexContextBlock can never silently drift. Ground truth is openai/codex @ rust-v0.172.0, codex-rs/core/src/context/contextual_user_message.rs (CONTEXTUAL_USER_FRAGMENT_MATCHERS) plus codex-rs/context-fragments/src/fragment.rs (matches_marked_text). Each case is the text of ONE user-role input_text content block; isContext says whether Codex classifies it as injected context. All paths and ids are synthesized. Add a row whenever upstream adds or changes a matcher.
